items.description: Featuring a mix of gameplay footage and real life action, this new Medal of Honor Warfighter SEAL Team trailer follows the actions of real SEALs as they take you through a series of high-intensity Demolitions in this Combat Training video.

items.title: g4tv.com-video61085: Medal of Honor Warfighter SEAL Team 6 Episode 6: Driving Tactics
items.description: Combat driving is a critical skill in urban environments. Ambushes happen at a moment's notice. Being able to instantaneously flip that switch from normal to full on and tactfully using your vehicle as your weapon can help you live to fight another day.
